phase: slice 1 pushed (Folio-backed records + playback scheduler); slices 2-3 (score audio path, harness program monitor) green locally, held until the steward sync adds pulse->score (normal) and harness->pulse

commits.subject: pulse/folio (SMB-PULSE-PLAYBACK slice 1): pulse edits Folio's markers, transitions and work area; playback scheduler with an audio master clock

capabilities_done: (1) model: pulse keeps no parallel marker/transition set; RecordEdit{AddMarker{scope}, ReplaceMarker, RemoveMarker, SetTransition{outgoing clip, Option<TimelineTransition>}, SetWorkArea} edits Folio's StudioMarker / TimelineTransition / WorkArea as one undoable proposal (plan_record_edit -> propose -> plan_timeline_revert); clip splits hand markers to the piece holding their start and the tail transition to the right piece (split_records in split_clip and write_pieces); every edit removes transitions that no longer play and lists them (EditProposal::dropped_transitions) and lists markers that left (removed_markers)

folio: StudioSequence.work_area (STU-VID-035), TimelineTransition.parameters [{param_key, param_value number|boolean|enumeration|ticks}] (STU-FX-103 keys, unique, <= 256, finite) and repeat_end_frame (STU-VID-032), all serde-default and omitted when unset (byte-identical old documents); param_value is not named 'value' because Folio's read-only extension check treats any object with key 'value' as a length

(2) PR-19 PlaybackScheduler: AudioClock port (sample rate + played samples), HeadlessClock, master ticks = anchor + ticks_from_samples (exact for rates dividing 254016000000); DropLate presents floor(master / tpf) and counts skipped frames (end-of-range skips included); PresentEveryFrame never skips and reports lag; play range = work area or whole sequence; pause/scrub/step frame-exact and clamped; frame_layers(tick) = enabled video tracks bottom-to-top with transition weights

stated tolerance (test playback_stays_within_one_frame_of_the_audio_clock): with DropLate at every presentation 0 <= master - frame_start < one frame period (40 ms at 25 fps); irregular presenter cadence of 1..4000 samples: presented + dropped = 100 of 100 frames, leads 0

spec_basis: STU-VID-023: 'a PROGRAM monitor showing the sequence at the playhead. Both expose: transport (play, stop, step forward, step back, play in-to-out, loop), an in point and an out point'
STU-VID-035: 'The work area is a named in/out span used to scope rendering and export; setting its bounds and rendering within it are typed commands.'
STU-VID-032: 'when insufficient handle exists Studio MUST report the shortfall and offer the declared choices (shorten the transition, shift the alignment, repeat the end frame)'
STU-FX-103: 'StudioEffectParameter is the single typed parameter record' (param_key identity); STU-FX-137 Track: 'volume (default 1.0, linear gain), pan (default 0), mute, solo'
STU-VID-021: 'the compositing order of video tracks is bottom-to-top'
notes.supersedes: 42005c4 replaced pulse's TimelineAnnotations / Marker / Transition / AnnotationEdit / plan_annotation_edit / follow_timeline_edit (lane SMB-PULSE-EDITING slices 3-4) with the Folio-backed RecordEdit API; the editing lane's marker/transition claims are carried here (same test names, rewritten)
notes.parity: Premiere transport, dissolve frame sampling and the shipped crossfade curve are UNVERIFIED (D5)
gaps: no media decoder in the harness: the viewer monitor needs a FrameSource (frame_unavailable otherwise); no audio device: the viewer uses a WallClock unless the host passes the score session
score mixes at most MAX_TRACKS (64) clips per session
crossfades on clips with a non-unit speed are audio_unsupported; head (single-sided) transitions are stored but not evaluated
loop playback and in/out-point play of STU-VID-023 not implemented
notes.known_defect_at_42005c4: TransitionParameter at 42005c4 serialises its value under the key 'value' with an internally tagged value_kind, which Folio's read-only extension check (an object with key 'value' must be a length) turns into a read-only document on inspect; found by the slice-2 folio test before any validation round; fixed in the pending slice-2 commit (param_value, externally tagged number|boolean|enumeration|ticks). Do not judge transition parameters at 42005c4.
